Resolver.SourceUrl: Download the Representative Console installer (sra-con-installer.exe) from your BeyondTrust Remote Support appliance. It is a per-appliance build with no public download URL.

Installation.OfflineFallback: This package is offline-only. The appliance-specific installer must be staged in Files\; there is no download fallback.

Provenance.Notes: OFFLINE-ONLY / APPLIANCE-SPECIFIC. sra-con-installer.exe is an NSIS (Nullsoft) installer signed by BeyondTrust Corporation, tied to a specific appliance hostname - no public download URL. Silent install '/S', silent uninstall via the bundled NSIS Uninstall.exe '/S'. The uninstall-registry DisplayName is per-site (site hostname under a BeyondTrust/Bomgar grouping); confirm the exact DisplayName in pilot and tighten the pattern. Refresh the staged media when the appliance is upgraded.
